speaker: barnaby_yaxley
text: The stool is yours, sir. The basin is for afterwards. The boy is for your shoulders, and not for talk.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A joined stool. I can hold a stool.

speaker: barnaby_yaxley
text: Hold the stool, sir, and think on your sins. It distracts.

speaker: barnaby_yaxley
text: A short first sin. You may name a second, if you are quick.

speaker: barnaby_yaxley
text: You got as far as the naming of it. That is as far as most men get.

speaker: barnaby_yaxley
text: There. Three roots, like a small black claw. Will you have it for a keepsake?

speaker: barnaby_yaxley
text: Then it does not leave with you. Twelve pence. A clout for the jaw. I am not walking you home.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Twelve. Tie the clout. I am not taking the tooth.

speaker: barnaby_yaxley
text: Off the stool when your legs agree to be legs. God keep you, sir.
